author: Mark Atwood
text: Blocked on canonical workspace propagation. Canonical jmap-mail-client at lib.rs:24-31 also does NOT re-export Id, State, or PatchObject — callers must add jmap-types as a direct dep there too. Fixing in metadata-client alone diverges from canonical. Workspace-wide policy decision: either (a) every extension-client re-exports the jmap-types primitives it surfaces in its signatures (canonical-template change, propagation to all 7 siblings + mail), or (b) accept the dep on jmap-types as the documented contract. Either way, decision lands canonical-first.
